small.$description: Corner radius for compact form controls, such as checkboxes.

medium.$description: Standard corner radius for interactive controls, including buttons, dropdowns, navigation items, inputs, and inline icon actions.
Corner radius for standard content containers, such as pagination, prompt suggestions, and chat messages.

large.$description: Corner radius for surfaces containing dense or extensive information, such as cards and modals.

pill.$description: Fully rounded ends. Reserved for badges, chips and dismiss targets (visual-design-decisions 4.1).

medium.$description: Standard height for interactive controls, including buttons, dropdowns, navigation items, and inputs.

small.$description: Height for compact interactive elements, such as the small button variant and chip.

icon.$description: Standard icon size used throughout the product.

medium.$description: 24px. Section-level loading and small avatar-like affordances.

large.$description: 48px. Page-level loading and large progress indicators.

tight.$description: Minimal spacing for closely related elements and compact padding.

compact.$description: Spacing for grouped elements and moderately dense padding.

comfortable.$description: Balanced spacing for standard padding and gaps between related elements.

standard.$description: Default spacing for content padding and gaps between sections of related content.

spacious.$description: Generous spacing for padding and gaps around substantial content and major layout regions.

thin.$description: 1px hairline stroke for containers, dividers and inputs.

medium.$description: 2px ring or emphasis stroke, for example the ring that separates a status dot from an avatar.
